title: Braze - Recommendations are message-centric, not storefront-native
clean_text: Braze's product recommendation capability is built for personalizing marketing messages rather than rendering recommendation widgets directly on the storefront, requiring brands to also operate a separate onsite personalization tool for product detail and category pages. Data-savvy teams report that Braze's audience segmentation feels constrained compared to more flexible alternatives, with real implications for overall marketing stack architecture. The platform is positioned for enterprise-level companies, making it less cost-effective for small businesses and startups.
